column2: Your AI agent just used two hundred eighty-seven thousand tokens. On what?
Claude Code, Codex, Gemini, OpenCode. Four agents, four log formats, and zero visibility.
Meet Know Your Tokens: one local dashboard for every AI coding agent.
Exact tokens for every request. Debug any prompt. And everything stays on your machine.
Run N P X know your tokens. It sets up a private environment, wires the hooks, finds your agents, and opens the dashboard.

This is your command center. Total tokens, input, output and cache, with a daily trend and the token mix. Cache reads usually dominate, and that's healthy: reused context costs a fraction of fresh input. Change the date range, and every card follows.
The Agents page puts every agent side by side, including anything you push through the API.
Requests lists every model call with its exact tokens. Click one to see its model, agent and prompt.

Here's the real power. This request used almost two hundred eighty-eight thousand tokens. The breakdown shows where they went, and the full prompt reveals the culprit: a whole log file pasted into context. Trim it, and the next request is a fraction of the size.
Projects show which sessions and requests use the most context, so you know exactly where to optimize.
See every tool call, skill and MCP server your agents use, and every session with its requests and tokens.
Before you paste something big, the token calculator estimates it offline, shows how much of the context window it takes, and prices it at your own rates.
Export everything as CSV, JSON or N D JSON, or build on the REST API and SDKs.
Using Antigravity, Cursor, or your own agent? Push one JSON record per request.
Every agent in. Every tool out. All local, and all yours.
Know Your Tokens is free and open source. Run N P X know your tokens, and give it a star on GitHub.
